issues.explanation: Chapter 56 ends with Zhou Yu falling unconscious from his reopened wound, but Chapter 57 immediately has him hearing reports and issuing orders without stating that his attendants rescued him and brought him back aboard the ship.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge such as: “左右急忙将周瑜救醒，扶回船中。周瑜刚听说玄德、孔明在前山饮酒，又得知刘封、关平截断水路，顿时怒不可遏。”
